findings.documented: Append it as a query parameter: GET /v1/listings?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
findings.actual: Query parameter ?api_key= is rejected with HTTP 401. API key must be sent in the X-API-Key request header.
findings.how_found: Sending api_key in query parameter returned 401; inspecting response indicated X-API-Key header requirement
findings.impact: All API requests fail with 401 Unauthorized unless the key is supplied via X-API-Key header

findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns 404; endpoint is served at /v1/listings/{listing_id}
findings.how_found: probed both singular and plural paths with sample listing ID
findings.impact: clients following doc cannot fetch individual listing details

findings.documented: returns active sale listings only; inactive, expired and withdrawn listings excluded server side
findings.actual: endpoint returns 730 listings where is_live is false
findings.how_found: audited is_live field across all retrievable listings
findings.impact: frontend must filter by is_live or display inactive status badge to users

findings.documented: each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property
findings.actual: multiple listing IDs describe the exact same property (same building, locality, BHK, floor, and area)
findings.how_found: grouped listings by apartment_name, locality, bedroom, carpet_area, and floor
findings.impact: users see repeated properties in search results

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns
findings.actual: total_listings is incorrect for 423 projects compared to actual /v1/listings count
findings.how_found: counted listings grouped by project_id and compared against project.total_listings
findings.impact: project cards show inaccurate inventory counts

findings.documented: posted_by_contact is the seller verified contact number
findings.actual: 50 listings appear to be fake/lead-generation duplicates sharing identical template text across properties
findings.how_found: clustered listings by identical description texts and contact patterns
findings.impact: pollutes search results with fake listings designed to capture buyer leads

findings.documented: Square feet, integer, everywhere in the API
findings.actual: some listings report carpet_area in square meters instead of square feet (e.g. area < 100 sqft for 2+ BHK)
findings.how_found: flagged 2+ BHK listings with carpet_area < 100 and price/sqft > 50,000
findings.impact: distorts price per square foot calculations unless converted
